recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-tiered composition featuring a vibrant vertical rainbow stripe background in the lower half and a stark black header block. The design utilizes bold, condensed sans-serif typography and isolated full-body figures of a musical group in dynamic, dancing poses.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical color stripes acting as individual stages for group members
Heavy black horizontal band anchoring the primary title text
High-contrast white-on-black and black-on-white text hierarchy
Dynamic human silhouettes contrasting against rigid geometric color blocks
coreInvariants: Six distinct vertical color stripes: Magenta, Cyan, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red
Condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif for the main title
Full-body photography of subjects in suits

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned in the lower two-thirds, scaled to fit within the vertical color bands, appearing to stand on a black base.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white condensed title in the upper black band acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down movement from the bold title to the rhythmic, dancing figures, ending at the tracklist footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black bands at the top and bottom provide structural negative space to contain the vibrant color spectrum.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black provides the structural frame and background for the primary text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White is used for maximum legibility of the main title against the black background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A six-color rainbow spectrum (CMY+RGB) creates a rhythmic, energetic background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the stripes contrasts with the zero-saturation black and white zones.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical condensation for the main title
Uniform stroke weight in the display text
Tight letter spacing (tracking) in the secondary titles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title features flat terminals and closed apertures
Secondary title in quotes uses a wider, more open grotesque style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed display font paired with a wider, more traditional grotesque for secondary information.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.
Matches the grotesque skeleton of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a background with a thick black band at the top, a thick black band at the bottom, and a middle section composed of six equal-width vertical stripes in magenta, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and red. Place full-body cutouts of men in 1960s suits in various dancing and musical poses across the stripes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, extra-condensed sans-serif font centered in the upper black band. Add a secondary title in a medium-sized, white grotesque font with a thin black outline above it. Add tracklist text in a small, white sans-serif font in the bottom black band.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly six vertical color stripes?
Is the main title extra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the background for the main title solid black?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black header and footer bands

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on color blocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the subjects appear to be standing on the bottom black band.
Verify the rainbow colors are vibrant and saturated.
Confirm the typography maintains a mid-century grotesque feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-color vertical stripe background with heavy black horizontal framing bands and bold, condensed sans-serif typography for a high-energy retro music aesthetic.
